hero.ability1: Blackfyre State: When an enemy Minion dies during your turn, you enter the Blackfyre State until end of turn.The first time you enter this state each turn, you gain 1 Lifeforce.
hero.ability2: Blackfyre Artillery: Once during your turn, while in the Blackfyre State, you may spend 1 Lifeforce to play a 3 or lower cost Weapon or Artifact from your Deck.
hero.ability3: Echoes of the Blackfyre: Once during your turn, while in the Blackfyre State, you may spend 1 Lifeforce to add a Weapon or Magic Card from your Graveyard to your Deck.
hero.ability4: Blackfyre Ward: Your Artifacts cannot be destroyed by Destroy Magic.
